sql: SELECT win_rate FROM main.mart_win_rate_by_close_quarter WHERE quarter = '2026-Q2'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE is_won AND closed_quarter = '2026-Q3'
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN is_won THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE furthest_open_stage_order >= (SELECT stage_order FROM main.mart_open_pipeline WHERE stage = 'Contract sent')
SELECT median_days_to_win FROM main.mart_deal_velocity WHERE quarter = '2026-Q1'
SELECT open_amount FROM main.mart_open_pipeline WHERE stage = 'Contract sent'
SELECT win_rate_reported FROM main.mart_win_rate_reported_vs_now WHERE quarter = '2026-Q2'
SELECT owner_name FROM main.mart_owner_win_rate WHERE quarter = '2026-Q3' ORDER BY win_rate DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT deals_won * 1.0 / deals_created FROM main.mart_win_rate_by_created_cohort WHERE cohort_quarter = '2026-Q1'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE was_moved_back
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE is_won AND closed_quarter = '2026-Q3'
